title: Chocolate-Deep Dark Secret
desc: Five Indians in London are caught in chaos when two are accused of a bomb blast. An Indian lawyer steps in, fighting against time and odds to prove their innocence.

title: Company
desc: Chandu and Mallik form a gang and gain notoriety. But ego and tension tear them apart, leading to betrayal and the collapse of their criminal empire.

title: Naseeb Apna Apna
desc: Plain-looking Chanda is shocked to find that her husband is married to an attractive woman. What will Chanda do?

title: Koyla
desc: Shankar, a mute servant, tricks Gauri into marrying his employer with a false photo. But Gauri falls for Shankar, fighting against odds to be with him.

title: Mrs. Chatterjee Vs Norway
desc: Debika Chatterjee fights Norwegian authorities to regain custody of her children, battling cultural bias and legal hurdles in a foreign land.

title: Gangubai Kathiawadi
desc: A young woman, duped and sold to a brothel, rises above despair. Using underworld connections, she transforms from pawn to ruler, commanding power in a ruthless world.

title: Simmba
desc: Simmba, a corrupt cop, works for smuggler Durva. But when Durva's brothers assault a woman, Simmba changes sides and seeks justice, risking everything to make things right.

title: Sikandar
desc: A young, driven rebel takes on a corrupt system, fighting for ordinary citizens' rights and shaking up the entrenched power structures of an unjust nation.

title: Pure Bollywood
desc: Bollywood songs - catchy, emotional, and upbeat - dominate the charts. From heartbreak to celebration, these tracks capture every mood, making people dance, cry, and sing along everywhere.

title: Ghajini
desc: After a brutal head injury, Sanjay loses the ability to retain memories beyond fifteen minutes. With clues tattooed on his body, he embarks on a relentless quest to find his fiancee's killer.

title: Hero
desc: A barber encounters his ex-lover at a ruthless gang leader's hideout and attempts a daring escape, triggering a chaotic chase as goons pursue them relentlessly.

title: Vivah - Journey From Engagment To Marriage
desc: Poonam, an orphan, is engaged to Prem from a wealthy family. Just two days before the wedding, her house catches fire, leaving her with first-degree burns.

title: King Uncle
desc: Industrialist Ashok Bansal's stern ways push his siblings away. When orphan girl Munna arrives, her warmth slowly melts his cold heart, bringing family back together.

title: Saand Ki Aankh
desc: Chandro and Prakashi, two women in their 60s, discover their shooting talent. With help from a coach, they challenge patriarchy and compete in national tournaments.

title: The Kerala Story 2: Goes Beyond
desc: Three women choose love over family expectations, but their dreams soon turn into hardship. Their journeys reveal how trust can become a path to loss and control.

title: Pushpa 2: The Rule
desc: A powerful smuggler faces a vengeful enemy while juggling politics and crime. A public apology sparks a tense showdown that leads to a dramatic challenge.

title: Bhoot Returns
desc: Tarun and Namrata move into a luxurious bungalow with their children, Taman and Nimmi. But mysterious events soon threaten their lives, forcing them to escape for survival.
